"6408 Ekkocardiografi" is a specific medical procedure code used within the Danish healthcare system to track and measure the quality of care for patients with atrial fibrillation. Specifically, it is one of the registered procedure codes in the [[sygesikringsregisteret|Sygesikringsregisteret]] used to identify [[ekkokardiografi|Ekkokardiografi]] examinations [^src1]. 

In the context of the Danish Clinical Quality Database for Atrial Fibrillation, managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), this code helps define the clinical indicators used to evaluate diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up care [^src1]. When calculating the quality indicator for echocardiography, 6408 is utilized alongside several other related codes in the register, including [[2208-ekkocardiografi|2208 Ekkocardiografi]], [[3810-ekkocardiografi-standardundersoegelse|3810 Ekkocardiografi, standardundersøgelse]], [[3811-ekkocardiografi-avanceret-undersoegelse|3811 Ekkocardiografi, avanceret undersøgelse]], [[5101-ekko-cardiografi|5101 EKKO-cardiografi]], [[5102-transsofageal-ekko|5102 Transsøfofagal ekko.]], [[5103-stress-ekkocardiogra|5103 Stress ekkocardiogra]], [[6402-ekkocardiografi|6402 Ekkocardiografi]], and [[0906-ekko-kardiografi|0906 Ekko-kardiografi]] [^src1]. These codes are essential for standardizing data collection, defining calculation rules for clinical quality indicators, and enabling regional comparisons of cardiovascular care quality across Denmark [^src2].
